Name: Everlasting Flowers (1.5 Legacy Version)
Author: Doragoun
Description:
[center][color=#ff0000][size=5]Note for 1.6:
[/size][/color][size=5]This is the legacy version of Everlasting Flowers that only works properly with Stardew Valley 1.5.
For an updated rewrite, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23833]please see the new mod page here[/url]﻿![/size]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/6eig3su.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[b][size=4][center][color=#ea9999]Everlasting Flowers[/color][/center][/size][/b]The main feature of this mod is, obviously, adding an entirely [b]new category of artisan goods[/b], the titular [color=#ea9999]Everlasting Flowers[/color], that are made with a special [b]new "machine"[/b], the [color=#9fc5e8]Enchanted Crystal[/color].

At the moment, there are [b]100 Everlasting Flowers [/b]- one corresponding to each of the vanilla flowers, two for dandelions and daffodils (because let's be honest, they are flowers and not forage) as well as a multicolored one that acts as a placeholder for modded flowers that don't have unique sprites.
Additionally, here's a list with all flower mods that have unique items with their own sprites, descriptions and gift tastes:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028]Mizu's Flowers [/url]﻿(19 flowers)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671]PPJA More Trees [/url]﻿(3 flowers growing on trees)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7110]Lumisteria's Flowers and Crops [/url]﻿(19 flowers)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15546]Trinkets [/url]﻿(2 flowers)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12274]Chickadee's Mini Stardrop Flower[/url] (1 flower)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4472]Ancient Crops [/url]﻿(2 flowers)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15107]Quaint Living [/url]﻿and its standalone versions (45 flowers!) - please see the pinned post if you use one of the standalone versions!
[/list]
Another feature: You can change the look of the vanilla Everlasting Flowers to [b]resemble the sprites from Vanilla Tweaks, Better Crops and Foraging or Cuter Crops and Foraging[/b].

The flowers are mainly intended to be sold for a decent amount of money compared to their unprocessed forms, however, they also make fairly good gifts. Some villagers love certain flowers, most like all of them, and Jas and Evelyn love them all. Vincent, however, is neutral to all of them (because let's be honest, what's he supposed to do with a flower in an unbreakable dome?). In addition to that, all potential vanilla spouses love Everlasting Roses. That leads us to...


[b][size=4][center][color=#ea9999]Custom Gift Dialogue[/color][/center][/size][/b]If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7304]Custom Gift Dialogue Utility[/url] installed (and you really should, having NPCs react to what you give them is amazing!), some villagers will have unique reactions to being gifted an Everlasting Flower. As a rule of thumb, some have generic lines towards any flower while others react to their favorite flower turned everlasting. Everlasting Roses of any kind in particular act as a token of love and friendship and elicit particularly heartfelt reactions from the vanilla bachelors and bachelorettes once you have a sufficiently close bond - in other words, once you reach 9 or more hearts and start dating them.

If you use something to make the relationship platonic and fear you'll have everyone confess their never-ending love for you, though, don't worry – once you launch the game with Everlasting Flowers installed, it will generate a [b]config file [/b]in the [CP] Everlasting Flowers folder that you can edit with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url](or a simple text editor, but I really recommend using GMCM). Using either option, you can decide whether you want the gift dialogue to play at all and which vilagers you want to have a romantic or platonic relationship with - see below for more information.


[b][size=4][center][color=#ea9999]Qu﻿ests and Events[/color][/center][/size][/b]Now you might be wondering how you actually unlock the crystal you need to turn normal flowers into everlasting ones. The answer is simple – magic! In either fall, summer or spring (see below), you'll receive a mail from the wizard in which he asks you to assist him in devising a spell that'll preserve flowers for eternity.
Once you've received that mail, head over to his tower to see an event that explains his theory and get a quest to bring him a certain flower. Once you've collected one and enter the tower again, you'll see another event that unlocks the crafting recipe for the crystal. With the recipe unlocked, you can craft the crystal using a diamond as well as 10 solar and void essences each.

One thing to note here: Neither of the two event scenes can be skipped because [s]I thought they were too breathtaking to miss[/s] the follow-up quest and the crafting recipe are unlocked during the scenes, not afterwards. We don't want anyone to miss them, right?

One more thing to note here: The second event plays once you've seen the first one and enter the wizard's tower with the requested flower in your inventory. You don't actually have to give the flower to him! In case you can't get the scene to play, please make sure you have the required flower in your inventory, exit the tower if you're already in there and then re-enter - that should make it trigger.




[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZvibCFY.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Make sure you have the required mods linked in the "requirements" tab above. Just to reiterate, these are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod [/url]as well as their respective dependencies. Additionally, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7304]Custom Gift Dialogue Utility[/url] if you want unique gift reactions to specific flowers and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFM Automate[/url] if you want the "machine" added by Everlasting Flowers to work with Automate.

Once you've made sure you've got all the required mods, simply download Everlasting Flowers and extract it into your mods folder - that's it!




[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/R8Z6KpG.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[b][size=4]Mod Compatability[/size]
[/b]I'm happy to say Everlasting Flower is fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Rasmodia[/url]: The events change slightly when either SVE or LUTI is installed so that no one ends up running into any furniture, walls or out of bounds. Additionally, if you use SVE and/or Rasmodia, both the mail delivering the quest and the quest entries in the notebook change to reflect the fact that Rasmodius goes by Magnus once you reach the necessary amount of hearts or that Rasmodia is, in fact, a woman.

[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
As I already noted above, the mod will automatically generate a config file in Everlasting Flowers' CP folder. You can edit the config using either any text editor or the far better option, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]. The options are fairly self-explanatory, but here's some more info:
[list]
[*][b]Unlocking Season [/b]can be either spring, summer or fall and decides when Razzy will send the mail that starts the Everlasting Flower quest line. The quest makes the most sense with the fall version, hence it's the default, but if you want to unlock everything sooner, more power to you!
[*][b]Unique Gift Dialogue [/b]turns unique reactions to everlasting flower gifts on and off, in case you don't want it... but why would you not want it?
[*][b]Relationship with [insert potential spouse name here][/b] for every bachelor and bachelorette can be either platonic or romantic. Depending on this setting, the bachelors and bachelorettes will have either platonic or romantic reactions to Everlasting Roses. They're all set to platonic by default, so you should change the one (or ones, I don't judge) for the NPCs you want to date to romantic.
[*][b][insert flower name here][/b] for every vanilla flower. These determine which item resprite the respective flower will match and can be either vanilla (self-explanatory), BCaF (Better Cros and Foraging), CCaF (Cuter Crops and Foraging) or VT (Vanilla Tweaks). You can mix and match them as you like!
[/list]
[size=4][b]Balance[/b][/size]
The prices for processed Everlasting Flowers are intended to be fairly close to the vanilla game's balance - the input flower's base price is multiplied by 2.5 while the processing itself takes 3 days. This means that processed fairy roses are very close to ancient fruit wine in terms of profitability over the span of one week. I'm honestly not entirely sure if I went overboard when it came to trying not to outshine vanilla ways of making money, though. If you have any thoughts on the matter, I'd be glad to hear them!

[b][size=4]Feedback[/size][/b]
Any and all feedback is more than appreciated. Like how the sprites look? Hate how the events are written? Can't get it to work or noticeda bug? Just leave a comment and I'll get back to you as soon as possible. Alternatively, feel free to ping me on the SDV discord server (same user name).

[b][size=4]Translations[/size][/b]
If you want to translate this mod, you're more than welcome to! It's fully internationalized (i18n'ed?) and currently available in English, German (both made by yours truly) and Chinese (huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/124328888]Luhasaname [/url]for that!). Just let me know if you want to make or already made a translation and I'll add it to the files asap.
[b]
[size=4]Mods in Screenshots[/size][/b]
The portraits used in the screenshots are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url] and the map recolor is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR[/url]. The trees in Shane's dialogue screenshot are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url]. I can only recommend all of them!

[b][size=4]Personal Edits[/size][/b]
Feel free to go ahead and make some personal edits and/or sprites for flowers I haven't made anything for yet! The base file I used for the dome is now downloadable in the optional downloads section as both an .ase file (with layers that make editing far easier) and a .png (without layers). A great free-to-use pixel art program is Libresprite. One thing, though - please ask me before uploading them to Nexus.




[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/bBUlZgl.png[/img][/center][b][size=4]Does this work on 1.6?[/size][/b]
I thought it should, but apparently, the answer is no and I'm not entirely sure changes made it break. I'm working on an update for this mod that'll migrate everything to CP, however, but I still need some more time. Please be patient. :)

[b][size=4]Is this safe to install or uninstall mid-save?[/size][/b]
It should be! While JSON Assets has historically had some problems with JSON shuffles, I think these should be mainly sorted out. I can't guarantee anything, of course, but I personally didn't run into any problems while testing the mod.
To uninstall, simply delete Everlasting Flowers from your mod folder. It's best to get rid of any items added by the mod beforehand, though, just to be safe.

[b][size=4]Will you make unique sprites and descriptions for modded flowers, too?[/size][/b]
Why thank you for being interested in more sprites, my dear imaginary inquirer. When I wrote this description, the answer was a definitive yes, but with 6 updates adding artisan goods for 89 (!) modded flowers, I'm pretty content with the state my mod's currently in.

Still, if you have any suggestions for other flowers I should make sprites for, please do leave a comment! I won't, however, make sprites for Farmer to Florist as it has very strict permissions – to be precise, it's not allowed to even link it as a required mod. Short form: no F2F, sorry!

Currently on the to-do list:
[list]
[*]Nothing, surprisingly!
[/list][size=4]
[b]Will you make more custom gift dialogue, maybe even for custom NPCs?[/b][/size]
Well, maybe. I haven't played SVE, ES or RSV enough (or at all) to have any idea how the potential spouses would react and don't want to write something wildly out of character, so for for the time being, the answer's no. Somewhere down the line, though, this might change.
